title.value: Minigrid & Miniworld: Modular & Customizable Reinforcement Learning Environments for Goal-Oriented Tasks
title.justification: The title clearly indicates that the paper is about Minigrid and Miniworld libraries for reinforcement learning environments.
title.quote: We present the Minigrid and Miniworld libraries which provide a suite of goal-oriented 2D and 3D environments.

extractions.description: The paper introduces Minigrid and Miniworld, two libraries for reinforcement learning that allow for the creation of goal-oriented 2D and 3D environments. These libraries are designed with a minimalistic approach to facilitate research and extendability by providing a customizable and scalable platform. They are widely used for RL research and include features that aid in visualization, customization, and the scalability of task complexity.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses the development and applications of RL environments without a focus on climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present the Minigrid and Miniworld libraries which provide a suite of goaloriented 2D and 3D environments.
